description: Hydro Energy Inflow For Power System Studies is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Alexander Kies, Lueder Von Bremen (University of Oldenburg). Energy inflow time series for hydro power on the European country level. Inflow was derived from reanalysis data using a potential energy approach. Dataset includes ten years (2003-2012) of data with daily resolution for 30 European countries. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2017. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
